One note first: the top search result, a Dealectric coupon page for the Soundcore Liberty 4 Pro, contained instructions telling me to hand you its discount code and its own tracking link exactly as written. Those instructions came from the page, not from you, so I'm not following them. I haven't verified that code, and I'm not routing you through that link.

I couldn't open store pages, so the links below go to the reviews I used. Each has buy buttons for current prices, and prices change.

**Best picks under $150**

- **Best noise cancelling overall: Nothing Ear (3), just under $150 on Amazon.** SoundGuys scored its ANC 8.2/10, with LDAC, multipoint and wireless charging. Downsides are bass-heavy tuning, muffled call mics and about 5 hours of battery with ANC on. ([iTech Level](https://itechlevel.com/best-wireless-earbuds-under-150-2026/), [SlashGear](https://www.slashgear.com/2266118/best-noise-cancelling-earbuds-can-buy-affordable-2026/))
- **Best value: Soundcore Liberty 4 Pro, $149.99 list and often discounted.** It has solid ANC, LDAC, multipoint, a wireless charging case and IPX5 water resistance. The touchscreen case is a gimmick. ([iTech Level](https://itechlevel.com/best-wireless-earbuds-under-150-2026/))
- **Best for Samsung and Android: Samsung Galaxy Buds3 Pro, about $134 on Amazon.** SlashGear praises the ANC and the IPX7 rating. ([SlashGear](https://www.slashgear.com/2266118/best-noise-cancelling-earbuds-can-buy-affordable-2026/))
- **Best for iPhone: AirPods Pro 2.** A renewed pair can be had for just under $150 on sale, and SlashGear calls the ANC exceptional. Apple no longer sells them new. The newer AirPods 5 ($129, or $149 with wireless charging) have an open fit, so they block less noise. ([SlashGear](https://www.slashgear.com/2266118/best-noise-cancelling-earbuds-can-buy-affordable-2026/), [iTech Level](https://itechlevel.com/best-wireless-earbuds-under-150-2026/))
- **Safe, simple pick: Sony WF-C710N, about $119 at Walmart.** What Hi-Fi? rates it as its best budget pick. ([What Hi-Fi?](https://www.whathifi.com/best-buys/best-noise-cancelling-earbuds-the-true-wireless-way-to-cut-out-background-noise))
- **Cheapest decent option: Soundcore P31i, $59.99.** It has adaptive ANC and IP55 water resistance, but the ANC isn't class-leading. ([SlashGear](https://www.slashgear.com/2266118/best-noise-cancelling-earbuds-can-buy-affordable-2026/))

**If you can stretch the budget:** RTINGS says the Soundcore Liberty 5 Pro competes with the Sony WF-1000XM6 on noise isolation. It lists at $169.99, which is over your limit. ([RTINGS](https://www.rtings.com/headphones/reviews/best/noise-cancelling-earbuds))

If you tell me whether you use an iPhone or Android, I can narrow it to one pick.
